## What changed

<!-- One or two sentences. For example: "Updated the examples on the Meta Descriptions page." -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Website text or images only (`library-context/`)
- [ ] Changed an existing skill (`plugins/<plugin>/skills/`)
- [ ] New skill
- [ ] New plugin
- [ ] New or changed prompt (`prompts/`)

## Checklist

- [ ] The **Validate** check passed. If it failed, open **Details** to see what to fix.
- [ ] New or changed skills and prompts were tried in Claude or ChatGPT at least once.
- [ ] New pages are marked `draft: true` until they are ready to appear on the website.
- [ ] Nothing internal: no customer names, private links, credentials, or internal-only process.
- [ ] If the **Capability summary** comment lists anything, "What changed" explains why.
